title: VGGT-Segmentor: Geometry-Enhanced Cross-View Segmentation
summary: VGGT-Segmentor transfers an object mask across severe viewpoint, scale, and occlusion changes by combining VGGT cross-view features with prompt fusion, point-guided prediction, and iterative mask refinement.

mechanisms.name: Geometry-enhanced cross-view mask transfer
mechanisms.description: Use a source object mask and geometry-aware cross-view features to form coarse projected point prompts, then refine them into a pixel-accurate target-view mask.
mechanisms.limitations: Cross-view segmentation performance on Ego-Exo4D does not establish physical door identity, metric door geometry, functional entrance status, arrival, user benefit, or safety. The source mask must already be authorized.
